outcome: amplitude-integrated electroencephalogram (aEEG) improvement at 48 hours of therapeutic hypothermia
major neurological sequelae at 12 and 24 months
cohort: 46 newborns treated with therapeutic hypothermia for a presumed diagnosis of HIE at a level III neonatal intensive care unit between January 2012 and July 2020
finding: While HIE was the most common cause of NE, other etiological factors, such as intracranial hemorrhage and infection, were identified in a significant proportion of cases, highlighting the importance of considering diagnoses beyond anoxic events.
mod_finding: Infants with confirmed HIE had a higher prevalence of emergency cesarean section compared to those with non-HIE NE.
